An original young woman with long, wavy black hair
walks a runway in a cream open-knit sweater with
distressed, frayed sleeves and hem. She wears
dark brown suede shorts with a wide tan leather
belt, white lace socks, and tall tan suede knee-high
boots with lace-up ties. She carries a large dark
brown leather tote. Her expression is calm and
direct. A pale gray backdrop with a warm brown
floor. Palette of cream, chocolate, and tan. Relaxed

editorial.
